t: This is Doctor Johnsons Buildings, in the City of London, postcode EC4Y. The buildings were designed by Sydney Smirke, a British architect who lived from 1798 to 1877. The material I have on him is brief, so I can't say much more about his career or about the story of these buildings. Take a moment to look at the architecture and the surrounding streets, and see how the buildings sit within this old part of the City.
